scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run models
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:spawn: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron -- --spawn-backend"
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron dist/electron/main.js
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:backend: dotnet publish backend/App/App.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o dist/backend
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p electron/electron-config.json && shx mkdir -p dist/electron/protobuf && shx cp electron/protobuf/protobuf.proto dist/electron/protobuf/
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run typecheck
scripts.coverage:backend: rimraf backend/TestResults backend/coveragereport && cd backend && dotnet test --solution backend.slnx -- --coverlet --coverlet-output-format cobertura --coverlet-include "[Core]*" --coverlet-include "[DataAccess]*" --coverlet-include "[Business]*" --coverlet-include "[Transport]*" --coverlet-include "[Platform.Windows]*" --coverlet-include "[App]*" --coverlet-exclude "[DataAccess]DataAccess.Migrations.*" && dotnet tool run reportgenerator -reports:TestResults/*.xml -targetdir:coveragereport -reporttypes:Html
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && tsc -p electron/electron-config.json --noEmit
